steps.title: Connect Your Amazon Account
steps.body: Secure OAuth flow connects to Selling Partner and Advertising APIs. Takes 3 minutes. We handle token management and renewals automatically.

steps.title: Choose Your Database
steps.body: Use our managed PostgreSQL (live in 60 seconds) or bring your own database credentials. Your data lands where YOU decide.

steps.title: Data Flows Automatically
steps.body: Scheduled syncs run on your timeline. Historical backfill loads your past data. Watch real-time status and get alerts if anything needs attention.

steps.title: Query, Analyze, Export
steps.body: Your data, your way. Write SQL queries, connect Tableau or Looker, export to CSV, feed your accounting system. No limits, no fees, no permission needed.

personas.title: Amazon-Native Brands
personas.body: You've built a real business on Amazon, not a side hustle. You need data infrastructure that matches your sophistication. Make decisions based on YOUR data in YOUR systems.

personas.title: Agencies & Aggregators
personas.body: Managing 10, 50, or 100+ seller accounts? Stop logging into separate dashboards. Unified multi-tenant platform with clean data separation and central oversight.

personas.title: Finance & Operations Teams
personas.body: Tired of reconciling numbers from three different sources? Get a single source of truth that feeds directly into your financial systems and operational dashboards.

personas.title: Data-Driven Leaders
personas.body: You want to train ML models, build predictive analytics, or create custom automation. You need raw data access, not another pretty dashboard you can't query.
